newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Air Ukraine adds second flight on Tianjin route.
newsitem.headline: Air Ukraine adds second flight on Tianjin route.

text.p: Air Ukraine will increase to twice a week from once its flight between Kiev and the Chinese Yellow Sea port of Tianjin, an airline official said on Tuesday.
The official said the second flight will start in July, in addition to the weekly Kiev-Beijing route.
He added that Ukraine's flag carrier serves all Chinese destinations with Soviet-made Tupolev Tu-154s but would be served by Boeing-767-200 ERs from next year.
Chinese destinations are popular among private traders of consumer goods from Ukraine and other ex-Soviet states.

Interfax news agency said Russian national carrier Aeroflot would on Tuesday add regular flights to the Ukrainian eastern industrial city of Dnipropetrovsk. The new route would be served with Tupolev Tu-134s three times per week.
Until now only the Dnipropetrovsk-based Dniproavia, an Air Ukraine affiliate, has been flying to Moscow.
